2226-2908-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2908-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2403-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2403-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Moonlit Wake and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-2464-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-849-2464-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-849-2464-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2558-4186-6495-6701.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2558-4186-6495-6701.notes:
The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-4506-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4506-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-4506-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

765-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

215-850-969.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-969.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

109-223-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
109-223-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Fork targeting the original Fork.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Fork copy, creating a copy of Fork, targeting the original Fork.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Fork copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

1486-3459-7223--67.description:
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the crew ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
969-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
969-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

2034-5086-5183-6291-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6291-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

4067-5181-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-5181-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Findbroker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Golgari Findbroker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Golgari Findbroker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3490-4017-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4017-5789.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4268-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4268-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-4063-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2232-4264-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-4264-6749.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {2}{G}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Altered Ego enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Altered Ego from the battlefield to your hand.
When Altered Ego leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Altered Ego from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

292-1495-5902.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-5902.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1020-3689-6518-6556.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

826-1636-2438-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-2438-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1621-1922-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Blur.
1621-1922-4605.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1049-2440-2511-4871.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, or an additional {R}, {W} or {B} if you haven't cast Jirina from the command zone this game
1049-2440-2511-4871.description:
Cast Jirina from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token for each time you've cast Jirina from the command zone this game.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier.
Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina and the Human Soldier die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, if you control a Human Soldier, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a Human Soldier.
If you sacrificed a Human Soldier this way, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 7 and 10, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.

1172-1624-5049.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-3968-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

575-2296-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one green card in hand.
575-2296-4674.description:
Activate Starved Rusalka by paying {G} and sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Starved Rusalka ability, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1636-3493-4949.notablePrerequisites: Patrol Signaler and Tazri do not have summoning sickness.
1636-3493-4949.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler and Tazri by tapping them, adding {1}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
When the Kithkin Soldier enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another creature with an activated ability that does not have summoning sickness, you may also tap that creature to get infinite colored mana that can only be spent to activate abilities.

2421-4005-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Syrix, adding {1}.
Choose not to move Syrix from your graveyard to the command zone.
Syrix dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {1}.
Skyfire Phoenix dies, triggering Syrix and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Syrix trigger, causing you to pay {2}{B}{R} to cast Syrix from your graveyard.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
